What each option catches, from the spot's script (Source) and each fish's fishing struct (skill_fishing/configs/fishing.struct): Base XP is its productexp / 10 (productexp is in tenths of XP), Low and High its success_low and success_high.

| Option | Level | Tool | Bait | Catch | Base XP | Low | High | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Net | - | Big fishing net | - | can't read this catch: it rolls with ~fish_roll_big_net, not ~fish_roll | - | - | - | skill_fishing/scripts/fishing_spots/memberfish.rs2:81 |
| Harpoon | 76 | Harpoon | - | Raw shark | 110 | 3 | 40 | skill_fishing/scripts/fishing_spots/memberfish.rs2:50 |

Low and high are the stat_random bounds: an attempt succeeds with chance (low + 1)/256 at Fishing level 1, rising evenly to (high + 1)/256 at 99 (server/engine/src/engine/script/handlers/PlayerOps.ts).

The server multiplies the base XP by its xpRate (25 on the local server, learnings/local-server.md).

## Movement

A spot teleports to a random tile of its movement enum that holds no other spot every 280 + random(250) ticks (skill_fishing/scripts/fishing_movement.rs2), so the spots of a shore roam over all of its tiles and a plan must stay within reach of every one. The area to copy is the centre of the tiles' box and a straight-line radius that reaches every tile with 3 tiles of margin, as a plan's `area` takes it.
